description: Hello, I am Khanifa. I am 13 and interested in bioengineering and astronomy. I code for 4 years, design apps and already participated in project competitions.
summary: ASTRA is a literal digital twin of astronauts and decision system created for missions. An algorithm with a Runge-Kutta ODE solver, EWMA baseline tracking, a 300-run Monte Carlo Go/No-Go option module, graph for showcasing the results and CCSDS-compliant export. HANIMONZ analyzes adaptations like muscle fatigue and immune system's changes using NASA datasets (OSD-570, OSD-356). Health dashboards only work with independent symptoms. ASTRA on the other hand is a system, where astronauts can regulate their daily routines.
details: HANIMONZ uses a Runge-Kutta 4th-order ODE solver, 14-day EWMA Z-scores to simulate adaptations across 180-day missions. Works independently on Edge AI during communication blackouts, creating a daily regulation. Prevents bone loss, cardiovascular strain, and sleep disruption by analyzing astronaut's personal data. Built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Chart.js, and an RK4 mathematical engine; benchmarks against NASA OSDR. A novel approach is in active data graphing, a 300-run Monte Carlo probability engine, and an interactive sandbox.
